messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

The Evanstonian is an upscale independent hotel. When a guest calls room service at The Evanstonian, the room-service manager takes down the order. She then submits an order ticket to the kitchen to begin preparing the food. She also gives an order to the sommelier (i.e., the wine waiter) to fetch wine from the cellar and to prepare any other alcoholic beverages. Eighty percent of room-service orders include wine or some other alcoholic beverage. Finally, she assigns the order to the waiter. While the kitchen and the sommelier are doing their tasks, the waiter readies a cart (i.e., puts a tablecloth on the cart and gathers silverware). The waiter is also responsible for nonalcoholic drinks. Once the food, wine, and cart are ready, the waiter delivers it to the guest ’ s room. After returning to the room-service station, the waiter debits the guest ’ s account. The waiter may wait to do the billing if he has another order to prepare or deliver.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"

                  exporter="Camunda Modeler"
                  exporterVersion="5.0.0">

  <!-- Collaboration definition with Pools and Lanes -->
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_RoomService">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Hotel" name="The Evanstonian - Room Service Process" processRef="Process_RoomService" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_RoomService" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_1">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Manager" name="Room-Service Manager">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_OrderReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TakeOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ForkManagerTasks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitKitchenOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AlcoholicBev</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_OrderWine</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MergeManagerTasks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignWaiter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Kitchen" name="Kitchen">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareFood</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Sommelier" name="Sommelier">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FetchWine</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Waiter" name="Waiter">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ForkParallelPrep</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReadyCart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareNonAlcoholic</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_JoinParallelPrep</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DeliverOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DebitAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_OrderCompleted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <!-- Manager Nodes -->
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderReceived" name="Guest order received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_To_TakeOrder</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeOrder" name="Take down order">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_To_TakeOrder</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_To_ForkManagerTasks</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ForkManagerTasks">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_To_ForkManagerTasks</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_To_SubmitKitchen</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_To_AlcoholicCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitKitchenOrder" name="Submit order ticket to kitchen">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_To_SubmitKitchen</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_To_PrepareFood</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AlcoholicBev" name="Includes alcoholic beverages?">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_To_AlcoholicCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_AlcoholicYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_AlcoholicNo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderWine" name="Give order to sommelier">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_AlcoholicYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_To_FetchWine</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeManagerTasks">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_From_FetchWine</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_AlcoholicNo</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_To_JoinManagerTasks</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssignWaiter" name="Assign order to waiter">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_To_JoinManagerTasks</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_To_ForkParallelPrep</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <!-- Kitchen Nodes -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareFood" name="Prepare food">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_To_PrepareFood</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_From_PrepareFood</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <!-- Sommelier Nodes -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FetchWine" name="Fetch wine and prepare alcoholic drinks">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_To_FetchWine</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_From_FetchWine</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <!-- Waiter Nodes -->
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ForkParallelPrep">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_To_ForkParallelPrep</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_To_ReadyCart</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_To_PrepNonAlc</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReadyCart" name="Ready cart (tablecloth & silverware)">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_To_ReadyCart</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_From_ReadyCart</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareNonAlcoholic" name="Prepare nonalcoholic drinks">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_To_PrepNonAlc</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_From_PrepNonAlc</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_JoinParallelPrep">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_From_PrepareFood</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_From_ReadyCart</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_From_PrepNonAlc</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_To_DeliverOrder</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeliverOrder" name="Deliver order to guest's room">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_To_DeliverOrder</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_To_DebitAccount</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DebitAccount" name="Debit guest's account">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_To_DebitAccount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_To_EndEvent</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderCompleted" name="Order completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_To_EndEvent</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <!-- Sequence Flows -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_To_TakeOrder" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderReceived" targetRef="Task_TakeOrder" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_To_ForkManagerTasks" sourceRef="Task_TakeOrder" targetRef="Gateway_ForkManagerTasks" />
    
    <!-- Manager Parallel Paths -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_To_SubmitKitchen" sourceRef="Gateway_ForkManagerTasks" targetRef="Task_SubmitKitchenOrder" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_To_AlcoholicCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_ForkManagerTasks" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholicBev" />
    
    <!-- Kitchen Path -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_To_PrepareFood" sourceRef="Task_SubmitKitchenOrder" targetRef="Task_PrepareFood" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_From_PrepareFood" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFood" targetRef="Gateway_JoinParallelPrep" />

    <!-- Alcoholic Beverage Decision Paths -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_AlcoholicYes" name="Yes (80%)" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholicBev" targetRef="Task_OrderWine">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_AlcoholicNo" name="No (20%)" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholicBev" targetRef="Gateway_MergeManagerTasks">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <!-- Sommelier Path -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_To_FetchWine" sourceRef="Task_OrderWine" targetRef="Task_FetchWine" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_From_FetchWine" sourceRef="Task_FetchWine" targetRef="Gateway_MergeManagerTasks" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_To_PrepNonAlc" sourceRef="Gateway_ForkParallelPrep" targetRef="Task_PrepareNonAlcoholic" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_To_DebitAccount" sourceRef="Task_DeliverOrder" targetRef="Task_DebitAccount" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_To_EndEvent" sourceRef="Task_DebitAccount" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderCompleted" />
